wordmark.purpose: The full bleed KOMBU mark in the home opening and the footer lid, grown to the gutters at 900 weight.

nav-mark.purpose: The small KOMBU mark inside the floating nav pill.

pagehead-title.purpose: The h1 on every interior page's opening card (PageHead), at the wordmark's 900 weight, capped by its own column width via cqw.

headline.purpose: Section headings (h2): One brand kept together, Selected work, What clients say, the contact card, and every card section heading.

title.purpose: Card and sub section titles (h3): tier names, ledger row titles, work card names, case study headings.

cell-title.purpose: Compartment titles (h2 in a tray card): 800, 40px to 64px, line-height 0.91, tight tracking; white on terracotta, linen on kelp, ink on ochre and mist.

lead.purpose: The lead paragraph under a section heading or beside a portrait: the One brand, kept together copy, about bio, contact copy, two column intros.

pagehead-lead.purpose: The lede directly under an interior page's h1, capped at 44ch (or larger and white on the terracotta head, for AA).

body.purpose: Default reading copy: the base body style set on body, inherited everywhere without an explicit override.

ledger.purpose: Ledger row copy: What I build, What I design, How I help, One trusted route.

control.purpose: Pill labels: every button and link styled as a pill, at the default size.

control-small.purpose: Small pill labels: the Visit pill on work cards, the segmented pricing switch.

chip.purpose: The fact chip: a single checkable figure, a real price, inside a linen pill with an ink outline.

tag.purpose: Small non interactive labels on white service cards: the tag row under What I build.

small-print.purpose: Footer row copy: copyright, the email link, the row below the footer's ruled divider.

motion.name: pill-hover
motion.value: transform 140ms ease-out, background 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Every pill's hover and focus state: a 2px downward translate, never a lift.

motion.name: wordmark-land
motion.purpose: Each KOMBU letter landing separately on load, from translateY(20px) scale(1.06) to rest, staggered via animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * 65ms). The page's one authored moment.

motion.name: example-tilt
motion.purpose: A tray card's two example tiles on hover or focus-within: the back tile to 4 degrees and up 3px, the front to minus 4 and down 3px, so the pair opens slightly. Frozen under reduced motion.

motion.name: preview-fade
motion.purpose: A recorded work preview's video fading in over its first-frame poster when it becomes the nearest visible card and starts playing, and back to the poster when it stops.

motion.name: marquee-drift
motion.purpose: The clients logo marquee's continuous drift, paused on hover.

motion.name: lightbox-crossfade
motion.purpose: The case study and gallery lightbox fading in and out over its ink overlay.

motion.name: lenis-scroll
motion.purpose: The smoothed wheel feel driving every scroll interaction across the site.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Grids go to one column: the reviews, the work grid, the help columns; the 404 tiles go two by two and its pills go full width.

breakpoints.name: tray-one-column
breakpoints.purpose: The home tray becomes one column, the wordmark drops to 29.8vw, the home introduction stacks its two lines, and the One brand copy card stacks over its proof grid.

breakpoints.name: mobile-nav
breakpoints.purpose: The floating nav collapses its links behind a Menu pill that opens the full-screen tray menu; the pricing tiers stack; page-head actions go full width.

breakpoints.name: two-column
breakpoints.purpose: The about card stacks its copy over the cutout, the work grid drops to two columns with the odd card centred, and interior two-column rows stack.

breakpoints.name: card-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Each tray card stacks its copy over its art box and footer, with the art box capped at 400px and centred.

narrative.northStar: One person, four disciplines, one tray.
narrative.overview:
Two references pinned by Ryan, fused rather than averaged. From EVOKE: the brand name set to the full page width as architecture, flat colour fields, no depth of any kind. From Bento: a warm linen canvas, full-bleed colour bands stacked like a lunch tray, sticker-like cards ringed in a thick ink outline, pill controls, big tightly-set type. The product supplies every fact; the references supply form.

The wordmark. KOMBU alone at the full page width, each letter landing separately on load (a short drop-and-settle, 65ms apart), one line of positioning copy beneath it, and the tray directly under that, all in normal flow. The earlier scroll-pinned sequence (the name sliding to the top and locking, the compartments popping in one by one) was retired on 8 September 2026: it had to fit the fold at every viewport and needed a new patch for each screen size, where a content-height opening does not. The page opens and closes on the wordmark: ink on linen at the top, linen on ink at the bottom.

One spacing scale (0.5 / 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 3rem). Inside any text block, heading to body is 1.5rem and body to action is 2rem, everywhere, via .stack. A section heading block to its grid or list is --sec-head (clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3rem), 48px on desktop) via .sec-head. Between sections: plain linen sections open with --band above; consecutive cards sit --gap apart.
keyCharacteristics: One person, four disciplines, one tray.
The wordmark is the lid, the four compartments underneath are the offer, the work sits inside them.
Full palette, committed at page scale. Fills own whole regions; nothing is scattered as accent over a neutral ground.
There are no shadows. Elevation is a 2px ink outline on every card, tile, pill and image frame.
Supermassive RS is the only display face, in three jobs: 900 for the wordmark and the page-head titles, 800 for section headings and card titles.
One authored moment: the wordmark landing on load. Lenis smooths the wheel. Nothing else animates on scroll; the recorded work previews play only while they are the nearest visible card.

rules.name: One Outline Weight
rules.body: Do keep every outline at 2px ink.

rules.name: Terracotta Carries Ink Text
rules.body: Terracotta is never used as small text on linen (2.7:1, fails); it is a fill only, always carrying ink text.

rules.name: White On Terracotta Only At Large Text Size
rules.body: Websites terracotta (title and lede white, the lede at 24px minimum so white on terracotta clears AA as large text)

rules.name: No Shadows Ever
rules.body: There are no shadows. Elevation is a 2px ink outline on every card, tile, pill and image frame, exactly as both references do it. A hover is a 2px downward translate, never a lift and never a glow.

rules.name: One Gutter Edge
rules.body: There is no content column. Every boxed grid and every band meets the same gutter, clamp(16px, 2vw, 28px), so the tray, the work cards and the wordmark share one edge at any width, including half of a 4K screen.

rules.name: The Stack Rhythm
rules.body: Inside any text block, heading to body is 1.5rem and body to action is 2rem, everywhere, via .stack.

rules.name: The Sec Head Rule
rules.body: A section heading block to its grid or list is --sec-head (clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3rem), 48px on desktop) via .sec-head.

rules.name: Headers Plain, No Eyebrows, No Full Stops
rules.body: Headers are plain labels except the one crafted line. No eyebrows or kickers above any heading. No full stops on headers.

rules.name: No Dashes In Copy
rules.body: First person singular, British English, no em or en dashes anywhere including aria-labels, never mentions AI.

rules.name: Content Sets The Height
rules.body: No section is sized to fit the viewport. The opening and the tray take their height from their content, so nothing needs a patch per screen size; the one authored moment happens on load, not on scroll.

rules.name: Decoration In Its Own Box
rules.body: Overlapping example tiles live in a square in-flow art box sized by its grid column and are positioned inside it by percentage, so they scale with the card and never collide with the heading.

dos: Do keep every outline at 2px ink.
Do keep terracotta as a fill that carries ink text.
Do keep the wordmark edge to edge on every viewport.
donts: Don't add a shadow, a gradient, a glass effect, an eyebrow, a section number, or a fifth fill. Don't size a section to fit the fold; content sets the height.
Don't set terracotta as small text on linen.
Don't let a compartment become an icon-heading-text card.
